name: Android Live Updates (promoted ongoing notifications)
plain: Android 16's progress-style notification that sits on the lock screen and status bar chip.
meaning: Gives rideshare, navigation and delivery apps a persistent live surface. Google limits it to specific styles and says it is not for ads, chat or package tracking.

android.store_policy: Play: navigation, calls, rideshare, delivery only
android.note: Must be ongoing with a title; Standard, BigText, Call, Progress or Metric style; no RemoteViews, not colorized, not a group summary; chip max 96 dp, text shown if under 7 chars; setWhen time at least 2 min away shows minutes

ios.note: iOS equivalent is Live Activities (ActivityKit); see mob.notif.live-activities

limits.headline: Can show a live progress card on your Android lock screen, if you allow it
limits.user_action: You start a ride, delivery, timer or navigation, and the app shows a Live Update
can: Show one ongoing card with progress, a title and a short status chip
Keep it on the lock screen while the task runs
Update it as the ride, order or trip moves along
cannot: Show it unless the app turned it on and you left the setting on
Use a custom layout or color it; Android 16 only allows set styles
Use it for ads or anything that is not a real ongoing task
Do this on iPhone, where the matching feature is called Live Activities
limits.differs: Android 16 calls it Live Updates. iPhone's version is Live Activities.

story.what_it_is: A live progress card for rides, deliveries and navigation that stays on the Android lock screen and status bar.

marketing.name: Live Updates
marketing.pitch: Android 16 adds Live Updates so people can follow a ride, delivery or navigation at a glance from the lock screen.

story.for_you: You order food and see a live bar on the lock screen and a small chip at the top of the screen. You can watch the courier get closer without opening the app.
story.for_makers: Makers get a prime spot that people check often. It is meant for time bound tasks like rides and deliveries, and Google says not to use it for ads or chat.

use_cases.example: Your car is two minutes away and the chip at the top of the screen counts it down.
A food order moves from preparing to on the way, shown as a live progress bar.
Turn by turn directions show the next turn on the lock screen.
A run in progress shows pace and distance as a card you can glance at.
A cloud gaming session or live match shows a running timer or score on the lock screen.
A live sports score or a flight boarding countdown updates in real time.
A timer or stopwatch app keeps the clock visible until it ends.

story.android_note: New in Android 16. Apps must use set styles, and you can turn it off per app.
story.ios_note: iOS has the same idea under the name Live Activities.

technical_bounds: Standard, BigText, Call, Progress or Metric styles only

history.change: Live Updates and promoted ongoing notifications introduced
No new Live Updates quota change documented; background audio and memory hardening ship alongside
